keywords: pcaversaccio 加入 EF 董事会
Glamsterdam 全部 Core EIP 提升为 SFI
EIP-8141 内存池替换与日志语义合并
Nethermind 与 ethrex 交叉测试 8141
summary: EF 博客宣布 pcaversaccio 加入 EF 董事会，首个任期一年，志愿担任。poojaranjan 依据 ACDC #183 决定提交 EIP-7773 修改，把 Glamsterdam 所有 Core EIP 提升为 SFI。EIP-8141 的内存池替换、驱逐与付款方敞口规则，以及交易日志集合语义合并；Nethermind 实现者在与 ethrex 交叉测试时发现三处歧义并提交澄清。EF 直播介绍 Freedom Factory 的 PQ1 后量子硬件钱包，据 Ethereal news #33 它为 ERC-4337 智能账户提供 SPHINCS+ 签名。

items.topic: EF 董事会与 Glamsterdam 范围
items.title: EF 博客：董事会更新
items.note: pcaversaccio 是 SEAL 911 联合创始人和负责人、EF Silviculture Society 成员，著有 The Ethereum Cypherpunk Manifesto；董事会现为 Aya Miyaguchi（主席）、Vitalik Buterin（创始人）、Patrick Storchenegger（瑞士法律顾问）和 pcaversaccio，他首个任期一年，志愿担任。EF 公告 19:04，pcaversaccio：无条件的隐私 19:13。
items.title_en: EF blog: board update
items.note_en: Pcaversaccio is co-founder and lead of SEAL 911, a member of the EF Silviculture Society, and author of The Ethereum Cypherpunk Manifesto; the board now consists of Aya Miyaguchi (President), Vitalik Buterin (Founder), Patrick Storchenegger (Swiss counsel) and pcaversaccio, who joins for an initial one-year term on a voluntary basis. EF announcement, 19:04; pcaversaccio: unconditional privacy, 19:13.

items.title: EIP-8141：澄清下限重定价、签名验证和 frame.value gas
items.note: （AnkushinDaniil）提交。他在 Nethermind 中实现 8141 并在 devnet 上与 ethrex 交叉测试，三处文字有多种读法，其中两处已造成实际分歧；例如 calldata 下限常量在本 EIP 中未定义，而 EIP-7976 会把同一常量从 10 改为 16。
items.title_en: EIP-8141: clarify floor repricing, signature validation and frame.value gas
items.note_en: (AnkushinDaniil), submitted. He is implementing 8141 in Nethermind and cross-testing against ethrex on a devnet; three passages can be read more than one way, and two have already caused real divergences. For example, the calldata floor constant is not defined in this EIP, while EIP-7976 redefines the same constant from 10 to 16.

items.title: EF：Ethereum Builders Live 介绍 PQ1 硬件钱包

items.title_en: EF: Ethereum Builders Live on the PQ1 hardware wallet
items.note_en: 23:01, with Freedom Factory CEO mhaas_eth discussing its quantum-resistant, fully open source hardware and software. Per Ethereal news #33, PQ1 provides post-quantum signatures (SPHINCS+C10) for ERC-4337 smart accounts, with dual secure enclaves and clear signing, at a $179 preorder, shipping Q4 2026.

keywords_en: all Glamsterdam Core EIPs promoted to SFI
EIP-8141 mempool replacement and log semantics merged
summary_en: The EF blog announced that pcaversaccio has joined the EF board for an initial one-year term on a voluntary basis. poojaranjan submitted an EIP-7773 change, based on ACDC #183 decisions, promoting all Glamsterdam Core EIPs to SFI. EIP-8141's mempool replacement, eviction and payer exposure rules and its transaction log set semantics merged; a Nethermind implementer cross-testing against ethrex found three ambiguities and submitted clarifications. An EF livestream presented Freedom Factory's PQ1 post-quantum hardware wallet, which per Ethereal news #33 provides SPHINCS+ signatures for ERC-4337 smart accounts.
